subject.title: refactor(agents): compress model prompts and tool instructions

question: May this PR intentionally change the values of deprecated GPT-5 prompt constants exported through the Plugin SDK?
rationale: The strings remain externally importable and the generated baseline records their changed values; deprecation discourages new use but does not itself define permission to break existing consumers.

options.title: Preserve Exported Values
options.body: Keep the existing Plugin SDK strings byte-stable and use separate compact internal constants for bundled runtime prompts.

options.title: Approve Changed Values
options.body: Accept the compatibility-visible change only with explicit ownership approval, focused consumer proof, and exact-head live behavior evidence.

recommendation.title: Preserve Exported Values
recommendation.body: Keep the existing Plugin SDK strings byte-stable and use separate compact internal constants for bundled runtime prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and later reduced the shared overlay surface and is the strongest history-backed owner of the prompt and SDK boundary.
